parameters.name: AppId
parameters.description: The application ID. You can call [QueryStudioAppList](~~216816~~) to query the ID.

parameters.name: DomainId
parameters.description: The domain name ID. You can call [QueryStudioAppDomainListOpen](~~216814~~) to query the ID.

parameters.name: IotInstanceId
parameters.description:
The instance ID.

<props="china">You can view the **ID** of the current instance on the **Instance Overview** page in the IoT Platform console. If the ID value exists, you must specify this parameter. Otherwise, the call fails.</props>

<props="china">
> If the public instance does not have an ID value, refer to [How to obtain an instance ID](~~267533~~).</props>

parameters.name: ProjectId
parameters.description:
The project ID.
1. Log on to the [IoT Platform console](https://studio.iot.aliyun.com/?spm=a2c4g.11186623.2.8.15b03118ooIo9y). In the upper-left corner, select the target instance, and then click Project Management in the left-side navigation pane.
2. In the common project list, find the target project, click the project card, and then view the project ID in the address bar.
